headline: Omilia Secures $67 Million in Series B Funding to Accelerate Global Expansion of Its Agentic Self-Learning CX Platform for Large Enterprises
summary: ATHENS, Greece & NEW YORK, August 06, 2026--Omilia, the Self-Learning Agentic CX company trusted by many of the world's largest enterprises, today announced a $67 million Series B funding round led by transatlantic software & AI specialist, Expedition Growth Capital.
